command: set -euo pipefail; adb shell input keyevent 26; sleep 2; adb shell wm dismiss-keyguard >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; sleep 1; test -n "$(adb shell pidof io.blueeye | tr -d '\r')"; adb shell dumpsys activity services io.blueeye | grep -q 'ScannerService'; adb shell dumpsys activity services io.blueeye | grep -q 'isForeground=true'; echo '--- SCANNER_LOGS ---'; adb logcat -d -v brief -s ScannerService:V BleScanner:V '*:S' | tail -n 80; echo SCREEN_OFF_WAKE_SMOKE_PASS
